title: Quantum-Classical Fragmentation with the Effective Fragment Molecular Orbital Method
summary: We present the quantum effective fragment molecular orbital (Q-EFMO) method, a hybrid framework that evaluates selected molecular-fragment correlation energies with the variational quantum eigensolver and assembles them through the size-consistent EFMO energy expression. A Hartree-Fock EFMO calculation supplies monomer references, many-body polarization, and distant-pair EFP interactions; independent VQE/UCCSD calculations provide correlation increments for monomers and selected near-field dimers.
